What this site does

fluqon.qpon surfaces retailer offers, coupon codes and unusual prices. We do not sell the goods, process your checkout or act for the retailer. The current feed is a demonstration: its sample codes and verification times are not live offers.

Check before you pay

Prices, stock, delivery costs, exclusions and eligibility can change. Check the final total and retailer terms before placing an order. A code appearing here does not guarantee it will work. A pricing error does not guarantee the retailer will honour it.

Purchases, cancellations, returns and warranties are handled by the retailer. Your rights under Australian Consumer Law still apply.

Keep it legitimate

Use publicly available offers within their conditions. Do not bypass security, access someone else's account or payment details, interfere with the site, or submit false reports. Tell us when a code is patched so we can check it.

Email alerts

Alerts are not open for sign-up yet. When they launch, you must choose to subscribe and confirm your email. Each alert will identify us and include a free unsubscribe option. No account required.

Links and commercial relationships

External websites have their own terms and privacy practices. If we earn a commission from a link, we will label it before you click. Our current sample links do not contain affiliate tracking codes.

Availability and responsibility

We take reasonable care, but cannot promise that every offer is accurate, available or up to date, or that this site will always be online. Nothing in these terms removes rights or remedies that Australian law protects. Any responsibility we cannot legally exclude stays with us.

Changes and questions

We may update these terms as the service changes. Updates apply from the date shown, not retrospectively to a dispute. Australian law applies, including the consumer protections available where you live. Questions or complaints: sayvon@fluqon.qpon.

Updated 24 October 2026.

Community contributions

You may propose offers and corrections using your own factual wording and sources you are entitled to share. Tell readers who receives any referral reward or commission. Do not invent a check, impersonate someone, post personal information or replace another person’s referral link without a clear review.

Contributions are reviewed. Acceptance records your public name and the change in a dated history; it does not guarantee a future checkout. A maintainer can reject, correct, restrict or remove material. You can raise a disagreement with sources through the contribution process.

You keep ownership of your original contribution. By submitting original offer text for inclusion, you license it under CC BY-SA 4.0. That permits reuse with attribution and the same sharing terms. Software uses AGPL-3.0-only. Retailer material, private records and reserved brand artwork are outside the contribution-text licence. Check contribute.fluq_ for current pilot availability. Reading and copying codes remain account-free.
